mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with declines in FEDFUNDS during periods of monetary easing.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP, combined with a decline in unemployment, indicates strong economic growth, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth and unemployment decline do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which may boost corporate revenues and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If payroll employment growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer price index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures, which may lead to monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPI growth does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates increased construction activity and economic growth, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
